questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Drive with caution and be ready to slow down.
Do not drive in this lane.
You must come to a complete stop and yield the right-of-way.
Slow down, be prepared to stop, and, if necessary, yield the right-of-way.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down, be prepared to stop, and, if necessary, yield the right-of-way.
questions.explanation: A triangular yield sign means you must slow down and be ready to stop. Let other vehicles, cyclists, and pedestrians pass before you continue.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that traffic flows in both directions ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that deer cross the road in this area. Slow down and watch for animals.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Watch for traffic on your right.
Don’t park on the right side of the street.

questions.explanation: A red circle with a slash means the action is not allowed. This sign prohibits right turns.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This hand signal is used when riding in groups to tell other riders to follow you.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You must bear either right or left.
A road joins from the right.

questions.correctAnswerText: You must bear either right or left.
questions.explanation: This sign shows a Y intersection ahead. You must choose to go either right or left.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This triangular sign means yield. Slow down, check for traffic, and let other vehicles and pedestrians pass. Stop only if necessary.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Yellow warning signs alert drivers to hazards ahead. This sign warns of a curve in the road.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This regulation sign tells drivers to stay in the right lane to avoid hazards ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This regulation sign prohibits right turns.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a traffic signal is coming up ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You must turn left or right.
You are approaching a T intersection.
The road that you are on intersects with a divided highway.
You are on an overpass above a divided highway.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road that you are on intersects with a divided highway.
questions.explanation: This sign tells you that your road crosses a divided highway. A divided highway has two one-way roads separated by a median or guide rail.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The road ahead is closed to traffic.
The highway ahead is undergoing maintenance.

questions.correctAnswerText: The highway ahead is undergoing maintenance.
questions.explanation: Orange construction signs warn drivers of work areas ahead. This sign tells you that road maintenance is happening. Reduce your speed and drive carefully through the work zone.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Hand signals help riders communicate in a group. When the lead rider holds their left arm out straight with palm up and swings it upward, it means increase your speed.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Don't drink if you are going to drive.

questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road becomes slippery when it is wet.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This regulation sign means you can turn left at a green light, but you must yield to oncoming traffic. Complete the turn when it is safe.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Hand signals show your intentions instead of using turn signals. When the left arm is extended straight out to the left, it means the rider plans to turn left or change lanes to the left.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This regulation sign means you cannot make a left turn at this location.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a roundabout is ahead. Slow down when entering and yield to traffic already in the roundabout.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Yellow warning signs alert you to hazards ahead. This sign warns you that the road curves back and forth. Slow down and adjust your speed for the curves.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a T intersection is ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road becomes slippery when wet.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a steep hill is ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You must travel at the speed indicated.
The maximum legal speed on the roadway is 55 mph.
You must travel through the intersection at the posted speed.

questions.correctAnswerText: The maximum legal speed on the roadway is 55 mph.
questions.explanation: This is a speed limit sign. It shows the highest legal speed you can drive on this road. In bad weather or poor conditions, you must drive slower than the posted limit.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means you cannot turn right. Do not make a right turn at this intersection.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Sharp right turn in the road ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: Sharp right turn in the road ahead.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a sharp right turn is coming ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are usually yellow with black markings and prepare you for upcoming road conditions. This sign tells you that traffic will merge from the right. Be ready to let them merge safely.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: There is a steep hill ahead.
No trucks are allowed on an upcoming hill.
There are trucks on an upcoming hill.

questions.correctAnswerText: There is a steep hill ahead.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a steep hill or downgrade is ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are usually yellow with black markings. This sign warns you that a T intersection is coming. Be ready to turn left or right.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You must come to a complete stop.
Drive with caution and be ready to stop.

questions.correctAnswerText: You must come to a complete stop.
questions.explanation: An eight-sided sign always means stop. You must come to a complete stop and wait for vehicles and pedestrians to clear before you proceed.
